memory_fit.hybrid_kv_floor_gotcha: This is a hybrid GDN/mamba model: the KV floor is dominated by fixed mamba-state pages + a forced 3056-token attention block granularity (+ up to 25% padding-layer waste), NOT by max_model_len. Floor 2.95 GiB @4096 vs 2.87 GiB @2560 — reducing max-model-len is nearly useless here. Fix = set kv-cache-memory-bytes ABOVE the floor.

attempts.result: ValueError: 2.95 GiB floor > 2.0 GiB (RCA fixed-KV, profiling skipped)
ValueError: 2.87 GiB floor > 2.6 GiB (floor barely moved — hybrid)
PASS — engine boots, FA2 NVFP4 backend active, graphs captured 0.18 GiB
AssertionError: Mamba-align block_size 3056 must be <= max_num_batched_tokens (self-inflicted; batched must be >= 3056)

memory_fit.spec_kv_inflation: ~7.6x — DFlash drafter weights (~3.2 GiB on GPU) + drafter/aux KV layers collapse the pool; this is the recon speed<->kv-max conflict manifesting.
memory_fit.note_initial_free_memory: gpu_worker logs 'Initial free memory 30.83 GiB' in all runs even though weights took 24.7 GiB on a 32 GiB card; with --kv-cache-memory-bytes set, profiling is SKIPPED so this number is not real post-weights free memory and must not be used for sizing.

a_praxis_verdict.verdict: NOT A-NO-GO (non-causal NVFP4 path exonerated, but E2E-unproven — blocked upstream)
a_praxis_verdict.reasoning: The task NO-GO trigger is garbage/NaN/abort INSIDE the non-causal path. That did NOT occur. Positive signals: (1) FlashInfer FA2 NVFP4 backend selected with V-scale deswizzle; (2) the non-causal DFlash drafter graph compiled (eagle_head) and CUDA-graph-captured without raise; (3) the profiling/warmup forward passed. But no drafter OUTPUT could be judged (coherence/determinism/acceptance) because token generation aborts before any accepted token — see blocker. So A is neither GO nor NO-GO from this window; it remains unproven pending the blocker fix.
a_praxis_verdict.coherence_determinism_under_spec: UNMEASURABLE (engine dies on first spec step)

e2e_blocker.class: DFlash x GDN spec-decode runner bug (out of scope: needs a code patch, not memory-fitting/serve-flags)
e2e_blocker.signature: CUDA device-side assert: indexSelectSmallIndex 'srcIndex < srcSelectDimSize' (aten/native/cuda/Indexing.cu:1515) = torch index_select with an out-of-bounds index
e2e_blocker.site: first spec-decode step (fires on the 8-token warmup request), model qwen3_next.forward -> vllm/model_executor/layers/mamba/gdn/qwen_gdn_linear_attn.py:1344 _forward_core -> causal_conv1d_update (_causal_conv1d_update_kernel JIT-compiled at inference for the 16-token spec-block shape)
e2e_blocker.localization: CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1 run pinned the assert to index_select at gpu_model_runner.execute_model (host-orchestrated gather), NOT a flashinfer/attention kernel

falsifications.not_capacity: fires on an 8-token warmup request (KV pool 4437 tok is ample for 8 tokens)
falsifications.not_vocab_mask: base vocab 248320 == drafter vocab 248320; mask_token_id 248070 in range
falsifications.not_seq_count: identical failure with max_num_seqs=4 and max_num_seqs=1
falsifications.not_noncausal_kernel: no NaN/raise in the FA2 NVFP4 non-causal path; failure is an integer index_select in the GDN/spec plumbing

e2e_blocker.hypothesis: DFlash proposer likely gathers per-layer target hidden states / GDN conv state with an index derived from raw target_layer_id (up to 62) into a small captured buffer (len ~5), or a spec-block state index, exceeding its dim on the multi-token (16) block. Fix belongs in the image's DFlash/GDN runner code (follow-up, not this window).

perf_base_nvfp4_no_spec.note: Isolation run (NVFP4-KV, NO dflash) to prove NVFP4-KV serving is E2E-sound and attribute the blocker to spec. Single-stream <100 tok/s is EXPECTED without speculation — >100 is exactly what DFlash would deliver and is what the blocker prevents.
